description: Finance operations agent that turns ambiguous business missions into approved GitLab execution plans, issue queues, control checks, and report packs.
primaryRuntime: Custom TypeScript agent runtime deployable beside Google Cloud Agent Builder or Cloud Run
agentInstructions: Break finance and operations goals into staged execution plans.
Require human approval before syncing operational work into GitLab.
Use GitLab MCP tools to discover capabilities and create labels, milestones, issues, and report handoff artifacts.
Preserve audit evidence, owner accountability, and redaction constraints.

tools.name: GitLab MCP
tools.purpose: Create and organize issues, milestones, labels, and execution artifacts in the team project.

tools.name: Gemini 3 planning
tools.purpose: Reason over messy goals, operational constraints, and evidence sources to produce structured mission plans.

safetyAndControl: Demo mode runs without credentials and never writes external data.
Live mode only executes after the user clicks Approve & sync.
Plans include owner, due date, labels, and audit evidence expectations before tool execution.
